text_block_list.text:
One day, while training was progressing 
smoothly in preparation for the battle at 
the Shuka Sho...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, there is something... I need 
to discuss with you.
choice_data_list:
You're being so formal— is something 
wrong?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"Prayers to the Saint, the frenzy 
surrounding Miss Buena... The tremors 
shaking the world are swelling like never 
before."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Buena decided to run in the Shuka Sho... 
and through tremendous training, she seems 
to have grown considerably.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"...The current me is not enough. Yes, not 
enough to break through the laws of this 
world."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I must grow even more, and make this a 
race like no one has ever seen before—!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: I request "extreme training."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Shatter the chains of common sense, and 
push yourself even further—enough to carve 
into your very soul.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The sublime ritual for this vessel to 
reach the 'Otherworld'—!

Remarkably, Red Desire requested an even 
heavier training load for her final 
stretch.

Putting any more strain on yourself 
carries a heavy risk. It is not something 
I can lightly approve.
However—

"If you truly desire victory in the Shuka 
Sho, you should believe in her."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... There is no need to worry. To 
complete the vessel of the Saint, heat 
fierce enough to scorch this flesh is 
necessary.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Only by discarding common sense and 
pushing past your limits... will the door 
to the "other world" open.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Will you walk with me... to the ends of 
this world?

(Right. My role is to send Red Desire off 
to the 'other world'.)
choice_data_list:
Yeah, understood. Let's push beyond the 
limit!

Yeah, got it. Let's push to the absolute 
limit!

text_block_list.text: —And then, the grueling final push began.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Hmph...! Ngh...!

Subjecting the body to far greater loads 
than ever before, every muscle was forged 
and honed to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Hah... Ugh, ...kgh...!!

Storming up the uphill track in a 
breathtaking time. Quickening the pace 
from the start, before forcing the body 
forward at the very end on sheer willpower 
alone—

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Hah... ngh...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahâ!!" his

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
(It's grueling enough to tear my body 
apart—— and yet, my heart is holding it 
together...!!)

It was truly the sheer tenacity of a 
saint, attempting to bend fate to her 
will.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: *pant*...—*pant*...

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"This pain... this suffering itself shall 
be the blessing that elevates me—...!"

Wearing pain as an honor and hardship as a 
joy, Red Desire's soul was about to enter 
a brand-new phase.

—And so arrived the fateful day of the 
Shuka Sho. Arriving early, I took a deep 
breath of the racetrack's crisp, clear 
air.

Having endured grueling late-charge 
training, Red Desire's mind is honed to 
the absolute limit.
choice_data_list: Desire, I know you can win!
Desire, if it's you, you're sure to win!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This day has finally arrived. The 
day I become my true self.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: …………The time has come.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Desire... What terrifying intensity. She's 
like an entirely different person compared 
to spring.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her opponent, Buena, looks calm as usual, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I honestly have no idea who's going to 
win. ...Man, please. Good luck to both of 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Desire-chan!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Buena-san... thank you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
"To have been born into the same world, 
and into the very same generation as you."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
And on this once-in-a-lifetime grand stage 
of the Triple Tiara races... I find 
happiness in being able to pour my soul 
into running alongside you.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
The Shuka Sho—victory will without a doubt 
be mine.

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
For the 'other world' I am destined to 
reach can only exist once I run alongside 
you, and triumph over you.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I'm sure I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who guided me to this 
place. That's why I'll answer you with 
everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Today, I will defeat Desire-chan and reach 
the ultimate "superb view."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —Without fail!

Even as they sought different "sceneries," 
their souls were unmistakably in 
resonance.

Shouldering countless expectations, hopes, 
and prayers, the two heroines step out 
onto the turf.

The final leg of the Triple Tiara, the 
Shuka Sho. The curtain rises on a legend 
right now—!
